messages:
Sam: Quick sync — we’re doing a staggered SDK/docs/sample-app launch across regions in two weeks. Changelog cutoff is EOD Friday. Who still has blockers?

Priya: Milestone status: docs + quickstarts targeted for Friday. Sample apps need the new streaming example update. Blocking: runtime feature flag and CI flaky on linux-arm matrix.

Diego: Docs PR is review-ready -> https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/428. I left one note on the API signature change. If SDK is stable, I can land docs after Maya confirms the sample snippet.

Maya: SDK update: streaming API changed from `stream(callback)` -> `stream({onChunk})`. It’s a small breaking change. I can add a compatibility shim `stream(callback) -> stream({onChunk: callback})` and a deprecation note. PR in flight, tests failing only on one flaky fixture. Expect PR by 3pm PT. :hourglass: 

Riley: I can toggle the runtime flag in staging tomorrow morning but need the exact env var and a smoke test command to validate. Also, CI timeout for linux-arm: I can bump timeout temporarily if someone files an infra ticket.

Maya: Env var is `FEATURE_STREAM_NEW_API=true`. Smoke test is `make smoke-stream && curl -sS http://staging-infer/health | jq .streams`. I’ll add a tiny smoke script to the SDK repo.

Diego: For docs/snippets, I need the final sampleapp code block that shows the new `onChunk` usage. Maya — can you paste the minimal example?

Maya: Minimal snippet:```js
const client = new Redwood({apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY});
client.stream({
  model: 'redwood/fast-stream',
  onChunk(chunk) { process.stdout.write(chunk.text); }
});
```

Priya: Sample app owners: can someone pick up updating the quickstart repo (quickstarts/streaming-example) to match that snippet? I can do it but will need CI green.

Sam: Volunteers: Priya will update quickstart; Maya will ship SDK shim PR by 3pm; Riley will flip staging flag and run Maya's smoke script tomorrow AM; Diego will land docs once Maya confirms sampleapp PR is green.

infra-bot: deploy-staging: stream-feature-toggle -> scheduled at 2024-11-12T09:00:00Z. Link: https://ci.redwood.internal/job/stream-toggle/1234 :gear: 

Riley: Filed infra ticket #INF-789 to bump linux-arm timeout and monitor. If CI still flakes, we’ll isolate the fixture and skip for this release.

Maya: Changelog snippet (for release notes):```- Changed: streaming API signature -> prefer {onChunk} callback. Backwards-compatible shim included; please update sample apps.```

Sam: Action items (TL;DR):
1) Maya: land shim PR + smoke script (owner) — due today 3pm PT.
2) Priya: update quickstart sample & open PR (owner) — due Friday EOD.
3) Riley: flip `FEATURE_STREAM_NEW_API` in staging + run smoke test — tomorrow AM.
4) Diego: finish docs review & merge once sampleapp PR green.
5) infra: monitor INF-789; consider timeout bump if flakes persist.

Sam: If anyone can’t hit these dates, call it out now so we don’t miss the changelog cutoff. :eyes: 

Priya: All good from my side unless CI blocks me. I’ll ping if I hit any infra blockers.

Diego: I’ll hold on merge until I see the sampleapp CI link.

Maya: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/sdk/pull/902 — tests flaky on `test/chunker_spec.js` only, working on it.

Sam: Perfect — thanks everyone. I’ll compile a tiny release-note draft after merges and drop into the release doc.

Priya: One more ask — can we add a single-line changelog entry under `Unreleased -> SDK` so Marketing has something to use? I can add it if Sam drops the text.

Sam: Done. I added the line: `SDK: improved streaming API (backwards-compatible shim); update quickstarts.` — feel free to iterate. :white_check_mark:
